name: kscan-live-vto
description: Isolated R&D workspace for the K Scan Live VTO Phase 1-2 program. Not a dependency of the kscan-app production package.json. See README.md for authority boundaries.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kscan-live-vto/garment-contract && npm run build -w @kscan-live-vto/contract && npm run build -w @kscan-live-vto/body-model && npm run build -w @kscan-live-vto/asset-pipeline && npm run build -w @kscan-live-vto/evaluation
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kscan-live-vto/garment-contract && npm run test -w @kscan-live-vto/contract && npm run test -w @kscan-live-vto/body-model && npm run test -w @kscan-live-vto/asset-pipeline && npm run test -w @kscan-live-vto/evaluation && npm run test:privacy
